edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

basis.en: Jin dynasty poem; the author died in 427.
basis.zh: 东晋诗，作者卒于 427 年。

note.en: The last four lines are among the most often quoted in Chinese, usually as advice to study hard. In the poem they follow an invitation to share wine with the neighbours, so Tao probably meant something warmer: the time to be kind and glad is now. Both readings are worth keeping.
note.zh: 最后四句是汉语里被引用最多的诗句之一，通常被当作勉励人用功读书的话。可在诗里，它们紧跟着一句邀请：斗酒聚比邻。所以陶渊明的意思大概更温暖一些：要待人好、要高兴，就趁现在。两种读法都值得留着。

excerpt.orig: 盛年不重來，一日難再晨。
excerpt.en: The prime of life does not come twice; / a day has only one morning.
excerpt.zh: 盛年不重来，一日难再晨。

gloss.en: No root, no stem: nothing holds a life in place.
gloss.zh: 根蒂：植物的根和蒂，比喻人生没有依托。

gloss.en: Dust on the road; 陌 is a path between fields.
No longer the self we were; 常 is constant, unchanging.
gloss.zh: 不再是原来那个恒常不变的身体。常：恒常。

gloss.en: Once born into the world, all are brothers: an echo of the Analects, ‘within the four seas all are brothers’.
gloss.zh: 人一出生就都是兄弟。化用《论语·颜渊》“四海之内，皆兄弟也”。

gloss.en: A dou of wine, a jugful; the dou, a measure of capacity, held roughly two litres in Tao’s time.
gloss.zh: 斗：容量单位，晋时一斗约合今两升。斗酒，一壶酒。

note.en: A warm invitation to share wine with the neighbours, ending in four lines that became a schoolroom motto; good Tao, though less distinctive than his best.
note.zh: 劝邻里共饮的温暖之作，结尾四句成了课堂上的座右铭；是好的陶诗，却不如他最好的作品独特。
